# Sleep Tracker Ai MCP

> Track sleep duration and quality, analyse patterns, and get personalised sleep recommendations

`sleep-tracker-ai-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install sleep-tracker-ai-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx sleep-tracker-ai-mcp
```

## Tools

- `log_sleep` — Log a sleep entry. Hours slept, quality 1-10 (10=best), optional bedtime/wake_time (HH:MM), and notes.
- `get_sleep_stats` — Get sleep statistics over the last N days. Includes averages, trends, and consistency scores.
- `analyze_patterns` — Analyse sleep patterns to find correlations between bedtime, duration, quality, and notes.
- `get_recommendations` — Get personalised sleep improvement recommendations based on your logged data.
